items.title: Bank of Ireland sets Aer Lingus card closure for 2027
items.why: Airline co-brand exits show how fragile partner-led cards become when the airline relationship changes.
items.summary_ai: Bank of Ireland will close its Aer Lingus co-branded credit card in 2027.
items.take: Airline co-brand exits show how fragile partner-led cards become when the airline relationship changes.
